verdict.rationale: Egnyte documents full-text search enabled by automatic OCR and semantic AI Search across content, which shows search reaches inside files. Its MCP integration lets AI clients query Egnyte content programmatically. However, the pack never documents a developer search API with filename and full-text query semantics. missing for 10: documented REST search API reference, explicit filename vs. full-text query parameters, confirmation that matching goes beyond prefix matching, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, search reaches inside files — a documented search API over filenames and full-text content, not just prefix matching

citations.quote: Ability to automatically perform optical character recognition (OCR) to enable full-text search and classification.
semantic search across all connected content repositories using natural language rather than keywords.
enables any MCP-compatible AI client (Claude, Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, and others) to query Egnyte content natively
